motions.topic: Make the next phase the structural antibody-antigen affinity scorer: fetch the SAbDab2 curated AI/ML training set (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20083994), featurize the binding interface (buried surface area, shape complementarity, interface electrostatics, CDR/antigen residues), train a delta_G predictor, and VALIDATE it against the SKEMPI2 delta_G data already in-tree. The TEST is explicit and pre-registered: report the trained model's Pearson r on held-out SKEMPI2 delta_G, and it must EXCEED the retired heuristic's 0.1971 (ideally >= 0.5) before the numeric Kd is un-retired; otherwise the numeric Kd stays retired and only the qualitative tier is published, exactly as it is today. Every figure carries its kind label (measured_on_host / derived / declared_constant); the van't Hoff r=0.9837 is the already-valid thermodynamics, not the new model's claim. MEASURED (this host): the AMP stage now calls DeepDTA (/crate/deepdta/predict) and the antibody stage's van't Hoff delta_G->Kd step is validated r=0.9837 against 441 real SKEMPI2 (dH,dS,Kd) pairs (datasets/skempi_v2.csv, 7,085 entries). The retired component is the composite->delta_G scoring: post-fit Pearson r = 0.1971 < 0.5 vs 6 therapeutic antibodies (antibody_binding_predictor.validate_benchmarks already retires the numeric Kd and publishes only the qualitative tier). So the one missing piece for a VALIDATED numeric Kd is a real structural scorer. Data sources identified: SAbDab2 (sabdab.opig.stats.ox.ac.uk, API 2.1.5) with its curated AI/ML training set at Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20083994 (cleaned antibody and antibody-antigen structures, versioned train/test splits); SKEMPI2 already in-tree. REJECT AS PREMATURE if the Zenodo training set cannot be fetched into this environment (network/storage), or if no held-out SKEMPI2 evaluation can be produced — in which case the numeric Kd remains RETIRED and the phase reports the fetch/featurize blocker as its result rather than asserting a scorer it does not have.
